outcome: Duration of first stage of labor
Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 35,146 women with live singleton deliveries at term (>=37 weeks of gestation), excluding elective cesarean deliveries, nonvertex presentation, and cesarean deliveries during the first stage of labor.
finding: The duration of the first stage of labor was significantly longer in nulliparous women compared to multiparous women, but cervical dilation rate was similar between the two groups during the latent phase.
